design.act: run Spec 028's Arm B machinery unchanged, separately on the seal-only and tablet-only sets of the Phase-393 analysis population (3,030 records, 6 sites), each stratum under the frozen family verdict rules, the headline pre-registered as one pattern (SPLIT / UNIFORM-PASS / UNIFORM-FAIL / THIN)
design.claim_under_test: STUDY-SPEC-028/ARM-B - INCONCLUSIVE on its recorded numbers (median adjusted R^2 0.0223721, interval [0.0122174, 0.0333271], rejection share 0.9548, drop-Harappa LOSO median 0.0066068 against the 0.01 margin); this variant appends a dated, stratum-resolved entry to that claim's record and never edits the frozen pooled verdict (DD-042-1)

step0_gates.check: every section 2 input hashes to its freeze-record value
the frozen population flow re-run on the pinned layer reproduces the recorded counts exactly (5,679 / 4,531 / 4,505 / 3,605 / 3,144 / 3,030) and the recorded Arm B analysis set
partition census by recorded object type, per stratum and per site, the two strata summing to 3,030; a record typed neither SEAL nor TAB stops the run
stratum floors: at least 6 sites each carrying at least 20 inscriptions of the type, per stratum

the un-split Arm B machinery on the full analysis population reproduces the recorded primary quantities exactly (median adjusted R^2 0.0223721, interval [0.0122174, 0.0333271], rejection share 0.9548, every recorded LOSO median including drop-Harappa 0.0066068)

verdict_rules.source: Spec 028's frozen family rules, carried verbatim (spec section 4.1); no threshold, margin, or clause is adjusted for the smaller stratum populations
verdict_rules.supported: within a stratum whose controls pass: the stratum's primary median adjusted R^2 is > 0.01 and every leave-one-site-out median adjusted R^2 of that stratum is > 0.01
verdict_rules.contradicted: within a stratum whose controls pass: >= 95% of the stratum's primary draws fail to reject, or the stratum's adjusted R^2 percentile interval lies entirely at or below 0.01
verdict_rules.inconclusive: within a stratum whose controls pass: neither SUPPORTED nor CONTRADICTED fires
verdict_rules.control_failure: a stratum whose controls fail is NOT ADJUDICATED - a machinery finding, never folded into INCONCLUSIVE - and the headline is NOT ADJUDICATED with the failing control named (DD-042-3, confirmed)

design.split_direction: a SPLIT is reported with its direction: SPLIT AS PREDICTED (seal SUPPORTED, tablet not) or SPLIT REVERSED (tablet SUPPORTED, seal not); a reversed split does not support the section 1.2 hypothesis as stated

stratum_floors.on_failure: the stratum is recorded TOO THIN with its counts, the execution closes at gate 0.4 with headline THIN, and neither stratum is computed (DD-042-2, confirmed: the headline is the pattern across strata, and a one-stratum result quoted alone would misstate the test)

design.machinery: Phase-393's Arm B machinery unchanged (specs/028-harappa-robustness/pipeline393.py as pinned): the same similarity-distance estimator, equal site weights with the recorded quota scheme, the same draw design and seed, the same negative and positive controls; the only change from the frozen Arm B run is the population - the stratum's records only
design.fences: no movement conclusion and no mechanism conclusion (spec section 7); period is described per stratum, not controlled (the period-controlled variant is design D-26, blocked, and is not merged); object type is as recorded within the Phase-393 layer only; the exploratory Arm C figures are the hypothesis's source, never evidence
design.execution_gate: Satisfied at the freeze of 2026-10-21 for the freeze act itself: execution runs as Phase-407 under this frozen contract on a separate execution order, and no stratum quantity was computed at the freeze - in particular the gate-0.3/0.4 stratum census appears nowhere in the frozen record

decisions.osf_registration: DD-042-6 (decided at freeze): this spec files its own OSF contract registration at the freeze, following the Spec 027/028 study-design pattern, so the split's gates, floors, and pattern rules are timestamped outside the repo before execution; the filing is recorded in osf-registration.md, completed by append after filing, and execution awaits its approval
decisions.synthetic_calibration: DD-042-7 (decided at freeze): a fresh synthetic calibration is DECLINED. Spec 028's calibration was required because Phase-393's machinery was new and its control construction changed before its freeze; here the machinery is byte-identical to the calibrated pipeline of record (pin re-derived at this freeze), its calibration stands on record with all four arm controls passing, and the variant changes only the input population. Gate 0.5 - exact reproduction of the recorded pooled quantities on the full population before any stratum quantity - is the variant's machinery check, and each stratum's own negative and positive controls run at its primary under the frozen definitions
decisions.margins_audit: DD-042-8 (decided at freeze): no separate margins audit is required. The draft's proposal is confirmed: this variant's margins instrument is the gate-0.3 partition census with the gate-0.4 floors - the census is computed at execution, before any stratum quantity, and a THIN closure publishes it as the finding. Spec 028's margins audit stands as a pinned input of record
decisions.dd_042_2: CONFIRMED as drafted: THIN closes the whole execution; neither stratum is computed when either is below its floor
decisions.dd_042_3: CONFIRMED as drafted: NOT ADJUDICATED is the control-failure class, named in the headline with the failing control
